author: Gert Marginet
name: CAT error definitions
description: The static class with the error definitions of a service and its prefix, with its test. The name is the name of the service area, such as Order. Run it in the folder of the solution of a service.

ServiceName.description: The full name of the service, such as Contoso.Shop.Orders.

Tests.description: Add the test. Use false for a service without the project ServiceName.CoreService.Tests.

Prefix.description: The prefix of the error codes: an application and an area of three letters, such as SVC-ORD. No other service may use the area.
